songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Gate cracks! Teeth first!
Late for supper, things get worse!

[Verse 1]
Skipped my supper, hit the graveyard, caught a flying shin;
Witch upon the wall just sent her skeletons marching in.
Crunch goes the ankle! Chalk across my tongue!
Brother says, "You can't eat every thing that tries to run!"
Fine, but tell the femur that it's looking pretty good.
Then a voice inside it whispers, "Tell her that I would."
Would what? Wait! That wasn't bone that spoke.
A father's name comes trembling through a mouth of copper smoke.

[Pre-Chorus]
Teeth stop! Eyes wide!
Someone's still alive inside!
Copper wire, stolen breath;
She's got them working after death!

[Chorus]
Bone chewer! Break the wire, not the soul!
Witch has got a graveyard under her control!
Came here hungry, now I'm bringing people home;
Get your filthy fingers off their bones!

[Verse 2]
Cauldron tips! Green slime slaps straight across my face!
Spit it out, shake it off, this is a disgrace!
I can smell the copper underneath the rot;
She's knotted every prisoner to something in that pot.
Gold inside a ribcage, locket on a thread;
Two small painted faces and a date before they're dead.
Don't look down! Don't think about your own!
There's still a way to get them out; quit chewing, find the knot!

[Pre-Chorus]
Hands shake! Jaw set!
Haven't broken something yet!
Copper wire, stolen breath;
Time to make her fear the dead!

[Chorus]
Bone chewer! Break the wire, not the soul!
Witch has got a graveyard under her control!
Came here hungry, now I'm bringing people home;
Get your filthy fingers off their bones!

[Verse 3]
Over fallen headstones with a locket in my teeth;
Slime has glued my tail to half the shrubbery beneath.
Rip it loose! Great, another naked patch!
She throws a burning skull; I send it hurtling back.
Bones are closing round me, but I hear the father's name;
One quick nod between us and he steps into her flame.
Copper flashes red along the line beneath his jaw.
There! Behind the kettle! That's the knot I'm looking for!

[Bridge]
My daughter waits beside the mill.
Tell her I am with her still.
Keep that thought! I'm nearly through!
I don't get paid to bury you!
Brace the gate and drop your head;
I'm cutting out the thread!

[Breakdown]
BREAK THE BINDING!
Give them back!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Staff across the cauldron, copper snapping at the seam;
She goes down the well before she finishes the scream.
Every bone falls empty; every borrowed shadow clears.
One cold hand against my cheek, then nothing but my tears.
Brother grabs my elbow: dawn is catching up with us.
Locket to the daughter, then a bucket for the dust.
Don't say "good girl." Don't you pat me on the head.
I can save a graveyard and still need to be fed!

[Final Chorus]
Bone chewer! Broke the wire, freed the soul!
Witch has lost the graveyard she could never own!
Came here hungry; brought her prisoners back home.
Some things matter more than chewing bones!

[Outro]
Soup's hot! Sit down!
Who the hell put bones in mine now?

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Three taps! Track shakes!
Move before the signal breaks!

[Verse 1]
Down the tunnel, copper stink, a claw against the rail;
Three cubs missing, witch ahead, a spark along my tail.
Silver whistle hits me like a needle in the ear.
Paws give way! Teeth clench! Can't tell far from near!
Whole damn station spinning while she laughs behind the glass;
I can smell the little ones but cannot get them past.
Then you strike the railway with the buckle of your belt;
Three clear knocks go through my bones, a road that can be felt.

[Pre-Chorus]
Tap twice! Turn right!
Keep that rhythm in my sight!
Head rings! Paws know!
Tell me when to move and go!

[Chorus]
Neon frequency, you're burning through my head!
Follow every footfall, not the lies the speakers spread!
Three small hearts are beating past the witch's wall of sound;
Keep the rails alive! I'm bringing all three out!

[Verse 2]
Belly low beneath the horns, she's sweeping every floor;
You tap left, I throw my weight against the service door.
Tail gets caught! Fur gets fried! Smell that lovely smoke!
Had it brushed an hour ago; somebody owes a coat!
Youngest cub is mouthing words the glass will never give;
She's bottled every frightened cry and feeds on what they miss.
She's about to twist a lid. The little one goes white.
No more time to wait for steady paws. I jump tonight!

[Pre-Chorus]
Tap twice! Glass cracks!
I can feel you at my back!
One breath! Straight through!
Three small lives and only two of you!

[Chorus]
Neon frequency, you're burning through my head!
Follow every footfall, not the lies the speakers spread!
Three small hearts are beating past the witch's wall of sound;
Keep the rails alive! I'm bringing all three out!

[Verse 3]
Bottle rolling, catch it! Wire round the throat!
Claw beneath the copper, sparks inside my coat!
She can't hear me coming over all her precious noise;
Good! I'm at the soundboard with a fistful of her toys.
You keep tapping faster as the service ladder bends;
I pass the little bodies through your waiting hands again.
One, two, three! Count them! Never trust the dark!
Now it's just the witch and me beside the breaker spark.

[Bridge]
All three here! I've got the gate!
Cut it now! Don't make me wait!
I heard enough to know that's you.
There's one more thing I've got to do.
Your little song is over, witch.
Watch me hit the switch!

[Breakdown]
CUT THE CIRCUIT!
Let them shout!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Lever down, the siren dies; she tumbles through the light.
Every bottled cry flies out and shatters in the night.
Cubs come running, talking all at once against my knees;
For a girl who wanted quiet, that's the sound I need.
Up the stairs in filthy dawn, your buckle keeps the count;
I can hear your laugh again above the engine's sound.
Still a ringing in my ears; I'm holding to your sleeve.
You're buying me a comb before we leave!

[Final Chorus]
Neon frequency, get out of my head!
Follow living footsteps where the signal used to spread!
Three small hearts are racing; every cub is safely out.
Turn the morning up! I've earned a little loud!

[Outro]
Train comes! Fur smokes!
You can stop with all the static jokes!

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Lace tight! Tail hid!
Mother, don't ask what your daughter did!

[Verse 1]
Pin the ears, tuck the tail, smile at the door;
Countess says the coat check's down beside the lower floor.
Count the steps, scent the air, something isn't right;
Brother wore that coat the day he vanished in the night.
There it hangs behind her chair, the patch I stitched in blue.
Why's the pocket torn? What did the bitch put him through?
Crystal flute against my teeth, a smile about to split;
Keep your hands from shaking, girl. Get on with it!

[Pre-Chorus]
Silk pulls! Claws slip!
There's his name against my lip!
Floor hums! Heart kicks!
Someone's breathing underneath the bricks!

[Chorus]
Silk and slaughter! Rip the hem and get him out!
Let them hear the wolf behind the pretty little mouth!
Keep your crown and candles; I have something worth the fight.
Mother's dress is not surviving this tonight!

[Verse 2]
Perfume, wax, and old wet blood beneath the polished stair;
Every guest is casting something hungry in the air.
Countess lifts her silver glass and says the meat is fresh.
I can feel my fangs against the velvet of my breath.
Heel snaps! Perfect! Leave it on the floor.
Cut the train to make a rope and jam the kitchen door.
Twist the silk around my wrist; the cellar's three floors deep.
Please let Mother's stitching hold. He's too far down to leap!

[Pre-Chorus]
Grip tight! Drop fast!
Should have worn the boots at last!
Hand here! Head low!
Keep your heartbeat where I know!

[Chorus]
Silk and slaughter! Rip the hem and get him out!
Let them hear the wolf behind the pretty little mouth!
Keep your crown and candles; I have something worth the fight.
Mother's dress is not surviving this tonight!

[Verse 3]
He's a coat of broken angles folded underneath a chain;
I can smell the medicine they used to hide the pain.
Easy! Not that shoulder! Put your weight across my back.
Something starts to crawl along the ceiling, long and black.
Bite the ribbon, pull the knot, let every velvet curtain fall;
Make the hungry things fight through the fabric in the hall.
He tries to crack a joke; I hear his teeth begin to knock.
Save it for the kitchen. We've still got to break the lock!

[Bridge]
You wore her best to come for me?
She's going to kill us for that seam.
Then keep on climbing! Let her try!
I'd like to see you both alive!
You've got the rail. I've got the door.
Keep moving! One floor more!

[Breakdown]
BREAK THE LOCK!
He's coming home!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Countess at the landing, teeth as bright as polished bone;
I drive her banquet knife into the thing beneath her gown.
Every borrowed shadow folds; the ballroom walls go slack.
Brother nearly falls; I catch the collar at his back.
Outside, cold! Coat round him! Run across the lawn!
I'll worry where the other heel has landed after dawn.
Mother takes one look, then pulls us both against her chest.
I start to say I'm sorry. She says, "Never mind the dress."

[Final Chorus]
Silk and slaughter! Tore the hem and brought him out!
They all heard the wolf behind the pretty little mouth!
Keep the crown and candles; I brought something home alive.
Mother's stitches held. Her children both survived!

[Outro]
Door shut! Kettle on!
Tell her that the shoes were already gone!

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Red lips! Wrong face!
Something just walked out and took my place!

[Verse 1]
Cherry red across the lip, a pawprint on the sink;
Made myself late again, too worried what he'd think.
Mirror says, "A little closer, let me fix that tooth."
Should have heard the hunger hiding underneath the truth.
Glass bends! Eyes blink! Somebody blinks twice!
She walks out wearing me and looking sickeningly nice.
I hit the frame, my muzzle shifts, the lipstick smears like jam.
Now the bloody mirror won't admit who I am!

[Pre-Chorus]
Ears up! Face gone!
That's my dress she's putting on!
Claws out! Door wide!
I'm not staying trapped inside!

[Chorus]
Gloss and grit! Get your fingers off my face!
I'm a wolf, not a mistake for you to quietly replace!
Keep your perfect little smile; I know the teeth beneath.
I want my own life back, and I am coming through to get it!

[Verse 2]
Down the market, slick with rain, mascara in my eyes;
She has got him by the wrist and feeds him little lies.
Says the beast behind them is a thing she used to know.
I can't get my words out fast enough to make him let her go.
Then he sees the cherry tracks beneath my muddy feet;
I left a trail of bad decisions halfway down the street.
He looks from her immaculate shoes to my demolished hair.
Laughs once. Drops her hand. He knows I'm there!

[Pre-Chorus]
Fake smile! Wrong scent!
Every perfect word was something lent!
One look! He knows!
Lipstick from my teeth down to my toes!

[Chorus]
Gloss and grit! Get your fingers off my face!
I'm a wolf, not a mistake for you to quietly replace!
Keep your perfect little smile; I know the teeth beneath.
I want my own life back, and I am coming through to get it!

[Verse 3]
She bolts back toward the shop; we skid between the carts.
Glass in every window showing girls pulled into parts.
One forgot her name; another traded off her scars.
All the missing selves are crowding underneath the glass.
I was going to look so lovely. I was going to feel so small.
God, I'm sick of begging something shiny for permission at all.
Grab the lantern! Light the frame! Show me where she hides!
I can smell her underneath a hundred borrowed lives!

[Bridge]
That's your face! Beside the crack!
Hit it now! I've got your back!
I see her! Hold the light right there!
One clean strike for every stolen hair!
There's the girl I used to be.
You don't get to keep her from me!

[Breakdown]
BREAK THE SPELL!
Give me back!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Claw meets silver, frame gives way, a hundred faces flash;
Mine hits home so hard I nearly fall into the glass.
Witch dissolves in little squares across the dirty tiles;
Funny how the last thing left is that expensive smile.
He gets me out, I wipe my nose, we miss the fancy dance.
Find a band inside a bar and give the night another chance.
Makeup's not the enemy; I like a little red.
It's the voice that says I owe it a different head!

[Final Chorus]
Gloss and grit! Put a grin across my face!
I'm a wolf, and not one piece of me is yours to replace!
I can wear the cherry red and keep the bite beneath.
I got my whole life back; you've got the mess to sweep!

[Outro]
My face! Your shirt!
Sorry for the lipstick. Not the dirt!

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Veil up! Sky cracks!
Everybody get the little ones back!

[Verse 1]
Pearls in the braid, paws out of the mud;
One whole afternoon of trying to look good.
Vows in my sleeve, heart in my throat;
Then a wedding gift starts humming underneath my coat.
Flash! Hot comb! Smoke along the lace!
Half my tail is standing straight in everybody's face.
Purple fur! Blue sparks! Pack begins to stare!
I've got the wedding of my dreams and lightning in my hair!

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't laugh! Don't look!
Who invited that old crook?
Dress burns! Jaw locks!
Witch has wired the wedding box!

[Chorus]
Static on the veil! Watch the perfect evening fry!
Every hair's a warning light against the wedding sky!
I wanted you to see me, not a walking power line.
If we're getting married, this is what you're getting, fine!

[Verse 2]
You reach across the aisle; I nearly knock you off your feet.
Voltage jumps the flowers, sets a ribbon smoking sweet.
Witch above the pine is lining up another shot;
There are cubs beneath that branch who haven't seen the spot.
Then I feel the charge pull hard against the cursed comb.
She's made my fur a lightning rod. Fine! Let's bring it home!
Hike the dress! Clear the chairs! Scramble up the rail!
Nobody stand underneath the catastrophic veil!

[Pre-Chorus]
Heads down! Move back!
Get the youngest to the pack!
Hands off! Comb hot!
Give me everything you've got!

[Chorus]
Static on the veil! Watch the perfect evening fry!
Every hair's a warning light against the wedding sky!
I wanted you to see me, not a walking power line.
If we're getting married, this is what you're getting, fine!

[Verse 3]
Thirty little buttons rip like gunfire down my back;
Mother's going to bill me for the fabric that I lack.
Catch the wire above the gate, loop it round the comb;
Pull the witch's next bolt through the iron into loam.
She's laughing till she feels her own spell tug against her sleeve.
That's right, sweetheart! You can have your wedding present, please!
All the pearls go flying as I swing across the tree;
I'm done being embarrassed. She's the one afraid of me!

[Bridge]
I came to marry you, not lace!
I know that furious little face!
Then catch the cubs! I'm coming down!
I've got the witch above the ground!
Keep the ring and hold the line!
One more spark and then you're mine!

[Breakdown]
GROUND THE STORM!
Break the broom!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Broomstick snaps against the wire; the curse reverses course.
She hits the dirt; the lightning dies; I land without much poise.
Dress in strips, knees in mud, you get there at a run.
I'm so mad I start to laugh before the tears are done.
Someone finds the rings beneath an overturned dessert;
You brush a blackened petal from my sleeve and ruined skirt.
Skip the pretty speeches! We've been standing here for years!
Kiss me before anything else explodes between my ears!

[Final Chorus]
Static on the veil! Let the wedding picture shine!
Every hair's a warning: this ridiculous wolf is mine!
You saw me at my worst and came in laughing through the fire.
Put the ring on! We can argue later with the choir!

[Outro]
Kiss first! Cake next!
Any jokes about the fur get hexed!

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Gate knocks! Cup falls!
That's my dead mother's voice outside the wall!

[Verse 1]
Kettle boiling over when the garden latch clicks twice;
Three years in the ground and there's my mother's voice.
Brother hits the doorway before I catch his sleeve.
Every stupid hope in me is begging to believe.
Hold it! Smell the wind! Something isn't there.
Cedar soap and baking flour should be in the air.
Nothing but a wet-ash stink and water from the well.
Why's she calling from a place she'd never let us go ourselves?

[Pre-Chorus]
Voice right! Scent wrong!
How the hell'd she learn that song?
Hands shake! Gate stays!
She's not taking him away!

[Chorus]
A voice without a scent! Don't you dare say our names!
You can borrow Mother's mouth; you cannot wear her place!
I want her back so badly I could tear this village down.
But you won't take my brother with her sound!

[Verse 2]
She steps between the sheets with Mother's crooked little smile.
Says she's been so cold, asks us to walk a little while.
Knows the song at bedtime, knows the secret by the stairs;
I can feel my brother leaning toward the thing out there.
She holds her arms out. Christ, I nearly let him go.
Then a claw beneath the cuff scrapes white against the stone.
Mother bit her nails; that hand is smooth as polished horn.
I catch him by the collar before he steps beyond the lawn!

[Pre-Chorus]
Eyes wet! Claws wide!
Keep the living one inside!
One lie! Too far!
I know what my mother's hands are!

[Chorus]
A voice without a scent! Don't you dare say our names!
You can borrow Mother's mouth; you cannot wear her place!
I want her back so badly I could tear this village down.
But you won't take my brother with her sound!

[Verse 3]
She screams my childhood nickname, sends it cracking through the yard.
I hit the gate so hard the hinges rip it from the bar.
Pull her sleeve! Charm beneath! Little teeth on string!
She's bottled up the things the dead no longer get to sing.
My brother throws the lantern; I can see the copper clasp.
She's wearing Mother's final breath inside a piece of glass.
Don't listen! Watch her wrists! She nearly has my throat!
I drive her backward, drag her over every splintered post!

[Bridge]
What if it's her? What if we're wrong?
I know that voice! I know that song!
I know! I want it just as much!
But she would never make us touch
The grave to prove we love her still!
Let go! Break the glass! I will!

[Breakdown]
LEAVE HER NAME!
Let her rest!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Charm hits stone, the borrowed voice comes ripping from her chest.
Witch falls empty at my feet; I can't make out the rest.
Brother's got me by the arm; he's pulling for the house.
I keep expecting Mother's voice to call and turn me round.
It doesn't. We keep running. Neither wants to look behind.
He says, "The kettle's burning," and it brings me back in time.
We slam the door together, both alive and badly scared.
It hurts because we loved her. That hurt is ours to bear!

[Final Chorus]
A voice without a scent! You don't get to use her name!
You can tear our grief wide open; we are not ashamed!
We wanted her so badly; still we held each other now.
You won't take the living with her sound!

[Outro]
Door locked! Tea spilled!
Brother breathing. Mother loved us. Still!

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Free brush! Fine print!
Somebody should have read the bloody print!

[Verse 1]
Tailor says she'll tame the frizz for half the going rate;
I am in her chair before my sister tells me wait.
Loose fur in a silver bowl, a ribbon round my throat;
Finally somebody knows what to do with this damn coat.
Walk out shining, turn the corner, sister hits the ground.
There's a mark around her ribs, though nothing's wrapped around.
Needle turns inside the shop. Her breathing starts to skip.
Oh, no. Oh, hell. What did that woman clip?

[Pre-Chorus]
Fur sold! Thread tight!
Little sister turning white!
Bow off! Door kicked!
What the hell have you stitched?

[Chorus]
Tailor of thorns! Get your needle out of her!
You don't own my family for a handful of my fur!
Wanted to look pretty, never signed their lives away.
Pull another thread and you'll be losing both your hands today!

[Verse 2]
Rows of tiny faces hanging underneath the loom;
Every spring coat we shed is breathing in this room.
Somebody's been taking fur from brushes, beds and shawls,
Making little bodies she can torture through the walls.
Sister's doll has copper pins around its tiny chest;
Mine is on a velvet cushion, better dressed than all the rest.
Nice work! Pretty stitches! Would you like to see me pose?
Put your needle down or I'll be wearing your damn clothes!

[Pre-Chorus]
Pins out! Count four!
Pack is breaking down the door!
One wrong thread could make her fall;
I have to keep my claws small!

[Chorus]
Tailor of thorns! Get your needle out of her!
You don't own my family for a handful of my fur!
Wanted to look pretty, never signed their lives away.
Pull another thread and you'll be losing both your hands today!

[Verse 3]
Fine claws, careful hands, heart jackhammering my chest;
All my life I've torn things up, now gentleness is the test.
Lift the copper from her throat, unwind it from her side;
I can hear her take a breath, then another breath outside.
Witch lunges for the spindle; brother knocks her off the stool.
I grab every little wolf and bundle up the wool.
Names first! Count twice! Feel for any heartbeat left!
Nobody gets abandoned in a sewing-room of death!

[Bridge]
Wanting care was not your crime!
Stop blaming yourself! We're out of time!
Then hold her hands and watch the wheel!
I've got the dolls; we've got the steel!
Sister's breathing! Door is clear!
Cut the red thread here!

[Breakdown]
CUT THE THREAD!
Free the pack!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Spool goes flying, needle snaps, the binding starts to fray;
Witch gets tangled in the hungry thread she used to make.
Brother drags me past the lint that's catching at the door;
I carry all the little wolves and one absurd couture.
Sister sits up coughing, takes one look and starts to grin.
"You paid for that? It's gray. I liked your coat before the trim."
I almost bite her. Then I hug her till she begs for air.
Tomorrow I am brushing it myself. Don't touch my hair!

[Final Chorus]
Tailor of thorns! Every needle's on the floor!
You don't own my family and you don't get any more!
Wanted to look pretty; brought my sister home instead.
Still a mess, still ours, and not a puppet on your thread!

[Outro]
Fur sheds! Pack lives!
That's the last free haircut anybody gives!

songs.title: First Moon, Last Match V5
songs.style: electronicore, heavy melodic metalcore, aggrotech, synthwave metal, 174 BPM, 4/4 meter, anxious relentless forward drive, immediate full-band attack, fast continuous double-kick drums, full-time snare on beats two and four, sixteenth-note hi-hats and bass sequencer, tight downtuned 7-string chugs, distorted supersaw hook, sharp acid synth accents, driving 808 sub bass, fast clear female lead vocals, aggressive pitched rhythmic singing, rapid syllabic delivery, clipped consonants, urgent short melodic chorus, brief high belt accents, sparse supporting male clean singing, one short male growled accent in Breakdown, English. Keep the same fast pulse through verses, choruses, bridge, breakdown and ending. Verse lines run across the beat with quick breath gaps; short chorus phrases keep moving. Four-bar instrumental break, percussion continues beneath all vocal exchanges. Racing double kick, urgent octave synth hook and clipped string accents. Female lead is quick, articulate and forceful through every verse. Male clean support appears only on the last two Bridge lines. Breakdown first line is one short male growl; second is a female clean attack. Chorus stays as fast and percussive as the verse.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
First moon! Barn shakes!
Apparently tonight's the night it wakes!

[Verse 1]
Sister in the hayloft with her hands inside her sleeves;
Says the claws are wrong, says she cannot make them leave.
I show the hole my first tail punched through Mother's Sunday chair;
She almost laughs. Then something dead starts climbing up the stair.
Lanterns out! Door buckles! Get behind my coat!
Demon's got a nursery rhyme stuck halfway down its throat.
She can't shift and cannot run, her own skin pulling tight.
All right, little terror, we are doing this tonight!

[Pre-Chorus]
Paw here! Look up!
You're not broken, you're a wolf!
Breathe once! Bite back!
I'm between you and the black!

[Chorus]
First moon, last match! Keep your claws against the beam!
Being scared is not the same as being beaten, stay with me!
I don't need you fearless, I just need you off the floor.
Let your sister be the monster at the door!

[Verse 2]
It wears a face she trusts; I hear her start to say its name.
I drive its teeth against the post; it spits a sheet of flame.
Hay goes up! Braid catches! Slap it with a sack!
There goes seven hours of grooming, smoking down my back.
Sister says I'm ugly now. I tell her, "Good! You too!"
She snorts through all the panic and the paws start coming through.
Good, use that! Dig in! Don't look at what they do!
The roof is better than the thing that's coming after you!

[Pre-Chorus]
Claws set! Pull hard!
I'm the bigger pain in this barn!
Smoke bites! Eyes sting!
You've got teeth now, use the things!

[Chorus]
First moon, last match! Keep your claws against the beam!
Being scared is not the same as being beaten, stay with me!
I don't need you fearless, I just need you off the floor.
Let your sister be the monster at the door!

[Verse 3]
One match in the pocket that the fire hasn't kissed;
Salt line by the doorway, if I can just reach it.
Demon grabs my ankle; new claws slash across its jaw.
Little sister's found a reason for the paws she never asked for.
She doesn't look like me; her coat is darker than the rain.
She scrambles up the beam and turns to call my name again.
Not a helpless little thing, not a beast that stole her place;
That's my sister looking back with soot across her face!

[Bridge]
Keep on climbing! I've got time!
That's a lie, but she'll be fine!
Strike the match against the nail!
Throw the salt beneath its tail!
Up here! Jump! We've got your wrist!
Come on, girl! You can't miss!

[Breakdown]
HOLD THE DOOR!
Let her through!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Salt catches, demon breaks, the barn gives one last shout;
She has got my sleeve between her teeth and hauls me out.
Both hit water, both come up, the cold knocks out our breath.
Then she's laughing hard enough to nearly drown herself to death.
Stop that! Swim first! Brag when we're ashore!
She's asking if we get to do it all again tomorrow.
Absolutely not! I'm taking two days off!
And if she mentions missing tail fur, she is getting dropped!

[Final Chorus]
First moon, last match! Look whose claws could hold the beam!
Being scared was not the same as being beaten, look at me!
You were shaking, you were brave, you pulled me off that floor.
Now there are two wolves standing at the door!

[Outro]
First brush! Long day!
Get those bloody paws out of my spray!

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Six bowls! One chair!
Still putting supper out for people who aren't there!

[Verse 1]
Killed the witch by daybreak; thought the aching ought to stop.
Came home to a kettle boiling dry upon the hob.
Coats along the hallway, muddy prints beneath the shelf;
Can't scrub out the silence, can't keep fighting with myself.
Then a shout beyond the mill, a running shape against the sleet.
I am through the doorway before boots can find my feet.
Someone's still alive out there. The thing behind him knows.
For once the fire has got a job besides warming up their ghosts!

[Pre-Chorus]
Gate wide! Run fast!
Get the living through the gap!
Hand here! Head down!
Not another body in this town!

[Chorus]
There's an empty place by the fire! Get inside!
You don't have to earn the right to make it through tonight!
I couldn't save my people, but I haven't lost my teeth.
It'll have to come through me to drag you underneath!

[Verse 2]
Young wolf shaking on the step, his ear a ragged knot;
Tells me what the witch left chained beneath the slaughter block.
Demon tracking everyone who made it out alive;
Once it learns a heartbeat, it can hear it miles behind.
Fine! Let it hear mine! Let it know which house is next!
I've been dying for a target that can answer what I felt.
Then I see him flinch from me, as if I'm one more thing to fear.
Easy, girl. He's not a weapon. He's the reason you're still here.

[Pre-Chorus]
Door braced! Chain rings!
Living heart behind my ribs!
Claws out! Eyes clear!
Fight for someone standing here!

[Chorus]
There's an empty place by the fire! Get inside!
You don't have to earn the right to make it through tonight!
I couldn't save my people, but I haven't lost my teeth.
It'll have to come through me to drag you underneath!

[Verse 3]
Black claws rake the shutters, little splinters hit the stew;
Even demons ought to know you don't destroy the food.
He starts apologizing for the trouble at the door.
Don't you dare! The witch sent that. You didn't ask for war.
Coats fall off their hooks; I catch my mother's by the sleeve.
I can save the cloth or catch his arm before he leaves.
I drop the coat. I catch the hand. He thinks he ought to go.
No! Stay and brace the table. You're not paying what I owe!

[Bridge]
I can't become the ones you lost!
I haven't got that kind of blood!
Then keep your name! I want you here!
Not a ghost to make the empty disappear!
Take the poker! Watch the chain!
We're both getting through the rain!

[Breakdown]
HOLD THE THRESHOLD!
Let him stay!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 4]
Demon lunges, table breaks, I drive it to the stone.
He brings the poker down; the chain splits to the bone.
Something drags it backward through the teeth of its own ring;
We slam the door so hard the pans begin to sing.
He's got the broom already; I can't help the startled laugh.
I didn't know a night could still leave something good intact.
Bread in half! Chair pulled up! Quit saying you're a guest!
We'll mend the stupid shutters when we've had a little rest!

[Final Chorus]
There's an empty place by the fire! You're inside!
You don't have to fill it just to stay another night!
I couldn't save my people, but their door still opens wide.
We kept somebody living. Keep the fire alive!

[Outro]
Six bowls! One more!
And wipe your paws before you cross that floor!
